title: Follow-through: the meeting is worth what happens after it

videos.script: Thiago tells Renata about the alert that woke him at three in the morning. She says she will sort it out. {{title}} Within a week there is a runbook page, and a second person he can call. A month later, he says that was when he decided the meetings were real. {{runbook}} Paula raises something too. Renata says she will think about it. Five weeks pass. Nothing happens, and Paula never mentions it again. {{silence}} She did not need to. The silence had answered her. {{answered}} This lesson is about the days after a one-to-one. Promises small enough to keep. Telling people what happened, even when the answer is no. {{loop}} And reading a quarter of notes together, to find what no single meeting shows. {{tally}}
